line_bound_derivation.current_source_caps: c9_stream output JSONL<=1MiB/line and<=512GiB/file; common generic JSONL<=8MiB; CSV decoder physical row<=2MiB; serial total output<=16GiB, input<=64GiB. These are rejection bounds, far too loose to establish workspace<=24GiB.
line_bound_derivation.frozen_candidate_requirement: For every output role freeze actual serializer, finite value ranges, capture_id/path length, event/unknown/state variants and maximum rows. For a fixed byte-template, Lx(N)=fixed_UTF8_key_and_punctuation_bytes + sum_j(max serialized scalar bytes_j(N)) + LF; decimal coordinate term digits(N), time term digits(first_ps+(N-1)*period_ps); raw vectors use exact bit width. Repeated canonical_row/source inside MATH_ROW_INDEX count every occurrence. CSV escaping counts each embedded quote twice and delimiters. General capture IDs and paths have no global finite bound until frozen.
line_bound_derivation.history_upper_bound: Before W supply finite Lfx/Ladvance/Linput_apply and Hfx/Ha/He from frozen stimulus/source contract or use N for each. Seven-row zero histories are no evidence those counts remain zero.
line_bound_derivation.metadata_upper_bound: Use explicit cardinality+serialized entry bounds for all plan/ledger/calendar arrays. Reject before execution if growing control document could exceed actual consumer identity/parser cap (R12 control cap8MiB, D4 legacy default16MiB; effective reachable cap=min of all readers) or 512MiB memory budget. Do not silently raise frozen limits or replace algorithm.
